findings.message: jsonl contains operator prompts verbatim; panel must never expose content fields or transcript endpoints.
No Anthropic Admin API — cost is computed from a versioned local pricing table; staleness must surface in the UI.
Codex thread_id does not correlate with Claude Code sessionId; do not attempt cross-provider session fusion.
Large jsonl files require incremental tail + checkpoint; DoS surface to be addressed by software-architect + devops-engineer.
Five operator defaults registered explicitly in lieu of grill-me; each marked overridable at the approval gate.

decisions_required: Retention policy: accept default of 180d raw + perpetual aggregates, or set explicit TTL.
Pricing table source of truth: in-repo Python module (auditable) vs ~/.dadaia/config/pricing.json (operator-editable).
Include opencode telemetry in v1 or defer to v1.1.
Canonical source for the Workflows map (.claude/skills/ vs specs/releases/*/PLAN.md vs other).
Treatment of events whose cwd falls outside any registered Spec Context (bucket 'unassigned' or discard).
Whether the panel emits threshold alerts (e.g. cost-per-day per agent) or stays purely informational.
Whether the local panel adds an auth token now that cost telemetry is exposed, or keeps 127.0.0.1 unauthenticated.
